feature_definitions.res60s1: lag 1 sum of 60 observed residual returns per listing segment, min_periods=60, centered percentile rank in [-1, 1]
feature_definitions.corporate_action_scale: Within each listing segment, cumulative product of observed AdjustmentFactor values; rows with factor 1 contribute a multiplier of 1
feature_definitions.prox250_split_safe: centered percentile rank in [-1, 1] of (Close / corporate_action_scale) divided by the rolling maximum of (High / corporate_action_scale), using raw Close/High and a 250-row window with 250 valid High observations required
feature_definitions.smoothing: EWMA alpha=0.25, adjust=False per listing segment

model: Deterministic equal-weight blend; no fitted parameters

selection_rule.primary: For descriptive comparison only: 3/4 fold net Sharpe improvement, median delta > 0, pooled delta > 0
selection_rule.turnover_control: Report turnover and cost; no post-result threshold or parameter change
